subject: Action plan: 4-week trial — scoring rubric, validators & handoffs
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@brighthealth.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Action plan: 4-week trial — scoring rubric, validators & handoffs

Hi Samira / Oliver —

Thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Per our call, attaching a concise plan to get the 4-week trial (POC) running quickly and with measurable success criteria. High-level summary below — full attachment: poc-success-rubric.xlsx

Goals / success metrics (proposed):
- Accuracy floor: auto-classification precision >= 88% on your labelled sample set (50k rows)
- Latency: median inference time <= 120ms for 512-token calls in prod-like environment
- Cost: average per-1k-token cost under your target (we'll run cost sims)
- Data controls: logs retained 30 days, no customer PII persisted in downstream traces

Timeline & ownership:
- Week 0 (this week): quick infra check + dataset handoff (owner: Oliver)
- Week 1: baseline runs + metric collection (owner: Rishi)
- Week 2: tuning (quantization/batching) + A/B on model variants (owner: Priyom)
- Week 3: integration tests in your staging + final acceptance checklist (owner: Marissa)

Weekly cadence: 30-minute syncs on Mondays 10:00am PT (starting 2027-01-11) for status + blockers. We'll send a short agenda and pre-read each Friday.

Immediate asks for BrightHealth: 1) dataset snapshot link (S3 or Drive), 2) a staging service account with read access to the dataset, 3) confirmation of your evaluation owners (who signs off on CX metrics).

I'll follow up with the signed onboarding playbook PDF and a short Ops checklist.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: poc-success-rubric.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)

Thanks for the clear summary and the rubric. Quick answers:
- Dataset: we'll share a 50k-row de-identified CSV by EOD today via the company S3 (link below).
- Staging account: setting up a read-only IAM role for Redwood; expect invite from our infra team by Tue morning.
- Evaluation owners: I'll be the business validator for accuracy; Oliver will own infra/ops acceptance.

One ask: can we include a checklist item that validates redaction of PHI at inference-time? Our compliance team requires it as part of sign-off.

Looping in a few infra notes from our side.

Samira / Oliver — quick heads-up on what we'll need to run realistic baselines:
- Example traffic profile (qps distribution, 95th percentile request sizes) — even a short sample is helpful.
- Expected concurrency during peak hours so we size the staging pool correctly.
- Any IP allowlists / VPC peering preferences — we can support both VPC peering and secure public endpoints.

On PHI redaction: we can add a middleware pass that strips fields flagged as PHI before logs are emitted. Rishi to own the POC implementation and include it in the Week 1 baseline run.

I'll draft a one-page ops checklist and drop it into the Drive link tonight.

— Rishi

Subject: Re: Action plan: 4-week trial — scoring rubric, validators & handoffs

Samira — quick note from the tuning side:

We'll run 2 quantized configs in Week 2 and a baseline FP32 variant in Week 1. To keep comparisons clean, please confirm:
- The canonical evaluation set (one CSV slice) we should use for scoring
- Whether your acceptance threshold is strict on precision or F1 — rubric currently lists precision >= 88% but we can flip to F1 if you prefer.

Also proposing a short internal checklist for handoffs:
- Data ingestion validated (owner: Oliver)
- Baseline run completed (owner: Rishi)
- Tuning experiments logged + metrics dashboard (owner: Priyom)
- Final acceptance sign-off (owner: Samira)

Happy to discuss in the Monday sync.

— Priyom
Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Weekly pulse: Week 1 status + 3 asks before tuning (short)

Hi all — quick weekly pulse after the baseline runs over the weekend. TL;DR: baseline complete; a few blockers to clear before Week 2 tuning:

Completed:
- Baseline FP32 run finished against the shared snapshot (Rishi) — raw precision: 85.6%
- Staging endpoints are up in our account; we've run load tests with 20 concurrent users

Open items (please action):
1) Oliver: confirm IAM role invite so we can run the scheduled tuning jobs in your staging by Tue AM
2) Samira: please confirm if we should switch the acceptance metric to F1 >= 0.86 (current FP32 F1=0.84) or keep precision >= 0.88
3) Marissa: I'll need a quick copy of your integration test plan for Week 3 validation (one-pager)

Next sync Monday 10:00am PT — agenda will include experiment matrix and rollback criteria.

Attachment: redwood-trial-ops-checklist.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Monica
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@brighthealth.io>

Subject: Re: Weekly pulse: Week 1 status + 3 asks before tuning (short)

Monica / team — thanks for the pulse. Quick responses and an ask:

Responses:
- IAM role: Oliver says invite sent on Fri; please confirm receipt (Oliver: can you paste the invite link into the thread?)
- Acceptance metric: we'll pivot to F1 >= 0.86 for the POC to better reflect our combined precision/recall needs
- Integration test plan: sending Marissa a short doc this afternoon; she'll own the Week 3 run.

Ask: the compliance team asked for a short note on log retention and sanitized logs. Can Redwood provide a two-paragraph summary we can share in our audit ticket? Ideally by Tue morning.

Progress note: we've run a small internal validation and the model is promising — a few FN patterns to address but nothing blocking. Looking forward to Week 2 tuning.

Best,
Samira
